about_the_game:
PIMPIT – The Ultimate 3D Car Tuning & Customization Simulator (Developed with Unreal Engine 5)

Customize. Visualize. Drive Your Dream.

Get ready for the most immersive car tuning experience! PIMPIT is a 3D car configurator and tuning simulator developed with Unreal Engine 5. Take control of real-world vehicles—off-road trucks, SUVs, sedans, and sports cars—and transform them with body kits, rims, spoilers, decals, wraps, and more. Whether you’re a seasoned tuner or just love customizing cars, PIMPIT gives you full creative freedom to design the ride of your dreams.

Key Features

• Massive Car Library – Explore off-road beasts, sleek SUVs, stylish sedans, and sporty coupes

• Full Customization – Upgrade hoods, bumpers, side skirts, spoilers, and more for the ultimate tuning setup

• Livery Editor – Personalize with 500+ decals, wraps, and 3D design elements

• High-Quality 3D Graphics – Experience stunning, real-time rendering powered by UE5

• Save & Share – Store your tuned cars in a virtual garage and show them off to friends

• Garage & Leaderboard (Coming Soon) – Compete with fellow car enthusiasts and discover top-rated designs

Whether you’re into off-road mods, sport car tuning, or simply love vehicle customization, PIMPIT lets you see every upgrade before you make it real. Download now and start building the custom car you’ve always wanted!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-2500K or Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 Super
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
